_comment: Seasonal events (app/outings.py). Dates are MM-DD in the state's time and may wrap the new year. An animal is in an event if its category is listed or its slug matches `match`; animals rated danger are always left out. Optional `states` limits an event to some states.

events.title: Winter Waterbirds
events.description: Ducks, geese and wading birds gather on lakes, marshes and bays for the winter.

events.title: Low Tide Days
events.description: Winter brings the lowest tides of the year. Check a tide table and look in the pools, without lifting rocks or animals.

events.title: Frog Chorus
events.description: Rainy nights wake up frogs, toads, newts and salamanders. Listen near ponds and wet woods.

events.title: Spring Migration
events.description: Birds are on the move and singing. Early mornings are best.

events.title: Butterfly Summer
events.description: Butterflies, moths, fireflies and other insects are out in gardens and meadows.

events.title: Fall Hawk Watch
events.description: Hawks, eagles and vultures ride the autumn winds. Scan ridges and open sky on clear afternoons.
